topics.title: Nouns
topics.goal: Help learners identify naming words for people, places, animals, and things.

topics.title: Pronouns
topics.goal: Help learners replace nouns correctly with words such as he, she, it, and they.

topics.title: Verbs
topics.goal: Help learners identify action words and use them in short sentences.

topics.title: Adjectives
topics.goal: Help learners describe nouns with simple descriptive words.

topics.title: Simple Sentence Structure
topics.goal: Help learners build clear subject-verb-object sentences.

topics.title: Basic Tenses
topics.goal: Help learners distinguish present, past, and future actions.

topics.title: Parts of Speech Overview
topics.goal: Help learners recognize the role of common word groups in a sentence.

topics.title: Comprehension Passage Support
topics.goal: Help learners read short passages and answer simple meaning-based questions.
